page.overview:
What is 3-Headed Saurian?

3-Headed Saurian belongs to Alien. The 3-Headed Saurian was a three-headed, dinosaur-like creature that lived in the modern South China Sea.

One of these was killed by a female Yautja.

In Alien, 3-Headed Saurian sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
